svg.title: Design Uber: the whole design on one interview board
svg.desc: A hand-drawn interview board for Uber. The rider app reaches a load balancer and an API gateway, which routes fare quotes to the Fare service (it calls the Maps API) and ride requests to the Ride service. The Ride service stores the ride as REQUESTED in the Spanner ride store and writes it to the Kafka ride queue keyed by pickup zone. Matching consumes it, reads nearby available drivers from the Redis geo index, ranks them with the ETA service and hands the best one to the offer workflow, which locks the driver in Redis for 10 seconds, sends the offer through the Notification service and push gateway, and runs the conditional commit in the ride store. Driver GPS rides the same stream to the Location service, which moves drivers between cells. Ride events feed Payments and the payment provider. Side notes hold estimates, the API, the Ride model and one closing note.

text.tspan: ~700 ride req/s peak, ~100k at one stadium
a driver in ~1 min, or "no drivers"

svg.text: region x N (everything keyed by the pickup region)

text.tspan: only if it is still my ride
